definition.label: WS-Addressing
definition.body: A standard that places transport-neutral routing information directly into the SOAP <Header> (e.g., <wsa:To>, <wsa:Action>, <wsa:MessageID>, and <wsa:ReplyTo>). This decouples message routing from the underlying transport protocol (such as HTTP or JMS), allowing stateful conversations, asynchronous callbacks, and multi-hop routing where responses can be directed to an endpoint different from the sender.
